display_name: Framework Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and Establishment of Trust (Korea), with its Enforcement Decree
authority: National Assembly of the Republic of Korea (an Act, 법률); the Enforcement Decree is a Presidential Decree (대통령령)
extent: Republic of Korea; Article 4(1) extends the Act to conduct abroad that affects the Korean market or users
citation: Act No. 20676 of 21 January 2025 (법률 제20676호), as amended by Act No. 21065 of 1 October 2025 and Act No. 21311 of 20 January 2026; in force from 22 January 2026
title_native: 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법
act_id: law.go.kr lsId 014820; current consolidation lsiSeq 282791 (Decree: lsiSeq 288781)

authoritative.note: Korean is the only text with legal effect. law.go.kr says its texts have no legal effect and the Official Gazette (관보) does; the Gazette was not consulted. Consolidation [시행 2026. 7. 21.] [법률 제21311호, 2026. 1. 20., 일부개정].

evidence.what: law.go.kr's delegated-rule popups for Act Art 32(3) and Decree Art 24(2), and an administrative-rule title search, showing no notice made under them as of 2026-10-24

aid_not_deposited.note: English translation headed [Enforcement Date 22. Jan, 2026.] [Act No.21311, 20. Jan, 2026., Partial Amendment]; read for cross-checking only; licence UNDETERMINED, so not deposited.

source.versions: The Act took effect on 2026-01-22 (Act No. 20676 addendum Art 1: one year after promulgation on 2025-01-21) together with Act No. 21311's amendments, except provisions that Act No. 21311 defers to 2026-07-21 (none of them in this encoding's scope). The Decree (No. 36053 of 2026-01-21) took effect on 2026-01-22 and was amended from 2026-07-21 and 2026-08-20; the provisions encoded carry no amendment mark.
